cards.title: Adding up per key
cards.body: To total values per key, add to what is already there. `get(key, 0)` starts a new key at 0.

hi.title: Har key ka total
hi.body: Har key ka total banane ke liye jo pehle se hai usme jodo. `get(key, 0)` nayi key ko 0 se shuru karta hai.

cards.title: Dictionaries remember order
cards.body: A dictionary keeps keys in the order they were first added. Updating a key later does not move it.

hi.title: Dictionaries order yaad rakhti hain
hi.body: Dictionary keys ko usi order mein rakhti hai jismein woh pehli baar jodi gayi. Baad mein key update karne se uski jagah nahi badalti.

cards.title: Spot the bug
cards.body: It should add up each item, but crashes with a `TypeError`. Which line is wrong?

bug.fix: `split()` gives text, so `qty` is `"2"`, not 2. Convert it before adding: `+ int(qty)`.

hi.title: Bug dhoondo
hi.body: Isse har item jodna chahiye, par yeh `TypeError` dekar crash hota hai. Kaunsi line galat hai?
hi.fix: `split()` text deta hai, isliye `qty` `"2"` hai, 2 nahi. Jodne se pehle convert karo: `+ int(qty)`.

check.question: What does this print?
check.explanation: x already holds 1, so it becomes 3. y is new, so get() starts it at 0 and it becomes 2.

hi.question: Yeh kya print karega?
hi.explanation: x mein pehle se 1 hai, isliye woh 3 ho jaata hai. y naya hai, isliye get() use 0 se shuru karta hai aur woh 2 ho jaata hai.

exercise.prompt: The first line is a count N; then N lines of `item quantity`, where the same item can appear more than once. Print each item once with its total, as `item total`, in the order items first appeared.
exercise.promptHi: Pehli line mein count N hai; phir `item quantity` ki N lines, jismein same item ek se zyada baar aa sakta hai. Har item ek baar uske total ke saath print karo, `item total` ki tarah, usi order mein jismein items pehli baar aaye.
